source.description:
Ella Chen’s Poised Portrait

Ella Chen appears in a striking studio portrait, dressed in an all-black ensemble with a gathered-front blouse and matching trousers. Her arms are crossed, and long, sparkling earrings frame her face, while a teal draped backdrop and subtle backlighting add depth and drama to the composition.

This image accompanies an article on the premiere of “乘風 2023,” the fourth season of the reality competition Sisters Who Make Waves. The season’s debut featured Ella’s nostalgic performance of “戀人未滿,” which earned her top scores and widespread praise, alongside other notable cast members such as Jia Jingwen and Xie Na.

source.description:
Ella Chen’s Reflective Portrait

Ella Chen leans forward in a clean, white studio environment, resting her chin on her folded arms. Her auburn hair is styled in loose waves, and she wears a black leather jacket that contrasts with the bright backdrop. The soft, even lighting accentuates her thoughtful gaze and natural makeup, conveying a calm, introspective mood.

This portrait aligns with the themes of her latest music video, "How Old Are You," which explores life’s pivotal choices through dual endings. The image’s simplicity and focus on Ella’s expression mirror the song’s message about embracing change without fear or societal pressure.
